regions.description: One entry per region given to you, in the same order, none added and none dropped.

region.description: Copied EXACTLY from the id of the region you were given. It is the key the next step (and the final file patch) answers against.

need.description: Copied EXACTLY from the need line you were given for this region.

group.description: The name of the group that covers this region, copied EXACTLY from the group list you were given. When NO group in that list covers it, answer the single word 'none' — never the closest-looking group, and never a group that is not in the list.

reason.description: One sentence saying why this group — or, on 'none', what the region needs and no listed group offers. On 'none' this is the whole answer the reader gets.
